ce.categoryRules: At least 25 hours Category 1 (as determined by NCCPA); remaining 25 may be Category 1, Category 2 or a mix. All hours in the 24 months before expiration. First Illinois renewal is exempt.

topicMandates.appliesTo: Medical personnel who work with children: training at least every 6 years plus an attestation at every renewal. Those who do not work with children may attest at each renewal instead of retraining. IDFPR lists PA, APRN and RN as medical personnel.

ce.controlledSubstanceCe: 1 hour safe opioid prescribing per controlled substance licence renewal (720 ILCS 570/315.5); 5 hours pharmacology annually if Schedule II is delegated (720 ILCS 570/303.05).

practice.agreementFilingAndRenewal: Written collaborative agreement required (except PAs privileged in a hospital, hospital affiliate, FQHC or ambulatory surgical treatment center under Sec. 7.7). A signed copy must be available to IDFPR on request; no renewal interval in statute. The collaborating physician files notice of any delegation of prescriptive authority and its termination.
practice.notes: Agreement adequate if the physician jointly formulates and approves orders or guidelines, periodically reviews them, and provides consultation at least once a month. A physician may collaborate with up to 7 full-time-equivalent PAs (hospital, affiliate, FQHC, ASTC exempt). A PA may keep practising up to 90 days after an agreement ends.

prescribing.separateAuthorityRegistration: Prescriptive authority is delegated by the collaborating physician in the written agreement; controlled substances require an Illinois mid-level practitioner controlled substances licence.
prescribing.ceForPrescribers: 1 hour safe opioid prescribing per CS licence renewal; Schedule II delegation adds 5 hours pharmacology every year.

unverified: Whether the 1 hour safe opioid prescribing CE (720 ILCS 570/315.5) is a 'statutorily mandated topic' that 2105-375 lets licensees spread over 3 renewal periods: 2105-375(d) carves out only implicit bias and sexual harassment, and the IDFPR CE page does not list the opioid hour at all. Treated as every pre-renewal period.

Whether the 2105-375 window is 3 or 4 renewal periods (4 if a new statutorily mandated topic was added after 1 January 2025): IDFPR now states the dementia and cultural competency cadence as once every six years, consistent with 3 biennial periods.
IDFPR lists a Notice of Written Collaborative Agreement form for PAs; whether filing it is mandatory beyond Sec. 7.5 (copy on request; physician files the delegation notice) was not confirmed.
Whether completed NCCPA recertification can substitute for the 50 PA hours: 1350.116 is silent; recorded as not accepted in lieu.
'reduced' practice authority for non-FPA NPs is a classification label; the primary sources confirm the collaborative agreement requirement and the FPA pathway.
Both practice Acts are scheduled for repeal on 1 January 2028 (routine Illinois sunset); renewal of the sunset not checked.
Federal DEA MATE Act one-time 8 hour training not re-verified here (federal); 720 ILCS 570/315.5 cites it as its basis.
verificationNotes: All researcher urls re-loaded with curl (JCAR 1350 and 1300 parts, ILCS pages, HB4369 status). Every quote matched. Added IDFPR CE page, 325 ILCS 5/4 and 77 IAC 3100. 225 ILCS 95 and 225 ILCS 65 sections are scheduled for repeal 1 January 2028.
corrections: IL sexual harassment training: hours changed from null to 1. The statute states no hours, but the IDFPR CE page (loaded) says a one-hour course each renewal cycle.

IL MISSED MANDATE added for PA, RN and APRN: child abuse mandated reporter training under 325 ILCS 5/4(k) (medical personnel working with children: training at least every 6 years plus attestation at every renewal; others may attest instead). IDFPR lists PA, APRN and RN as medical personnel.
IL Schedule II pharmacology (5 hours): period changed from 'every N years' to 'every year' to match 'annually' in 720 ILCS 570/303.05.

IL safe opioid hour: researcher tied it to the CS licence renewal; the statute says 'during the pre-renewal period'. Reworded. The CS licence expires with the professional licence (77 IAC 3100.30), so the periods coincide.
IL dementia and cultural competency appliesTo reworded to the IDFPR page: before the first renewal requiring CE, then once every six years.

IL PA: added facts for the CS licence expiry (77 IAC 3100.30, resolves a researcher unverified item), the hospital/FQHC/ASTC exemption from the mid-level CS licence (7.7(c)), the 90-day grace (7.6), and the 7 FTE ratio, which the researcher stated without a fact entry.
IL PA Practice Act and Nurse Practice Act sections carry a sunset: scheduled for repeal on 1 January 2028 (shown on every section loaded). Recorded in verificationNotes.

IL NP: added fact entries for the RN and APRN mandated reporter mandate, sexual harassment hour, dementia and cultural cadence, CS licence expiry, hospital/ASTC CS exemption (65-45(a-3)), the 50/30 CE split, first-renewal exemption for APRN CE, and FPA Schedule II narcotic consultation. Each was in the researcher prose with no fact or was missing.
